verdict.description: APPROVE if you would be willing to have this change on main; REQUEST_CHANGES if a finding must be fixed first; COULD_NOT_REVIEW if you could not finish the review, with why in body. A COULD_NOT_REVIEW answer is not posted.

body.description: The review body, posted on the pull request's head commit: what you checked, what you verified against the repository rather than took from the pull request's description, and anything you could not check or reach.

comments.description: One inline comment for each finding; an empty list when there is none.

path.description: The path of the file the finding is in, relative to the repository root, such as scripts/thing.py.

line.description: The line number the finding is on, counted from 1, in the file as it is at the head commit.

body.description: The finding: one finding only, naming the input, state or timing that makes the code do something it should not.

note.description: What merge-lane-2 needs to know that does not belong in the review, such as a design concern, one sentence for each thing; an empty string when there is nothing. The note goes to merge-lane-2 alone and is never posted.
